description: Trigger evals for foundation-audit: it compares design tokens in code against the foundation docs (and optionally Figma variables) and reports drift, while its siblings bootstrap a design system, extract foundations from screens, review one component against its spec, or check contrast pairs.

should_trigger: Are our tokens and the docs still saying the same thing? Devs have been adding stuff to packages/design-system/src/tokens for months.

Design just tweaked the brand blue in Figma and someone bumped it in code last week. Check whether docs/research/foundations/color.md, the token files and the Figma variables all agree on the value now.
I suspect spacing.md lists a few steps that never made it into the tokens folder, and the tokens have some steps nobody wrote down. Go through both and tell me what does not match.

We are about to cut a design system release. Diff the token JSON against the foundation docs and give me a per-foundation list of anything missing, extra or with a different value, plus how bad it is.
The button looks a shade off from the docs. Before I touch anything, compare the documented color tokens with what is actually exported in code and flag any renamed ones too.

should_not_trigger.prompt: New project, we have a Figma file and no docs folder or token files yet. Pull the variables out and set up the foundations docs and the directory structure from scratch.
We have twelve SCREEN_SPEC files full of raw hex values and pixel sizes. Turn them into color, typography and spacing foundation docs with role tokens.
The new Card component is merged. Check whether it matches its spec page for variants, states, focus behavior and token usage.
Walk through every atom in the design system and check each one against COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md for memoization, touch target size and reduced motion.

We checked last week that the token files and color.md agree. What nobody has checked is whether the text and surface pairs listed in color.md pass 4.5:1 and 3:1 in both light and dark. Go through every documented pair and suggest token changes for the ones that fail.
